Here are 30 companies as JSON. I wrote this from memory and didn't open the links, so a few URLs may have moved. Entries with a GitHub repo as the source show Rust use in their open-source code, not a company blog statement.

```json
[
  {"company": "Cloudflare", "use": "Pingora, the HTTP proxy that handles much of Cloudflare's traffic", "source": "https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-we-built-pingora-the-proxy-that-connects-cloudflare-to-the-internet/"},
  {"company": "Discord", "use": "Read States service, rewritten from Go for lower latency", "source": "https://discord.com/blog/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust"},
  {"company": "Dropbox", "use": "Sync engine rewrite (Nucleus)", "source": "https://dropbox.tech/infrastructure/rewriting-the-heart-of-our-sync-engine"},
  {"company": "Amazon Web Services", "use": "Firecracker microVMs, S3 and EC2 components, Bottlerocket", "source": "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/why-aws-loves-rust-and-how-wed-like-to-help/"},
  {"company": "Microsoft", "use": "Safe systems programming, including Windows components and Azure", "source": "https://msrc.microsoft.com/blog/2019/07/why-rust-for-safe-systems-programming/"},
  {"company": "Google", "use": "Android platform code", "source": "https://security.googleblog.com/2021/04/rust-in-android-platform.html"},
  {"company": "Meta", "use": "Rust is an endorsed server-side language, used for source control backend and other services", "source": "https://engineering.fb.com/2022/07/27/developer-tools/programming-languages-endorsed-for-server-side-use-at-meta/"},
  {"company": "Mozilla", "use": "Stylo CSS engine in Firefox", "source": "https://hacks.mozilla.org/2017/08/inside-a-super-fast-css-engine-quantum-css-aka-stylo/"},
  {"company": "Figma", "use": "Multiplayer sync server", "source": "https://www.figma.com/blog/rust-in-production-at-figma/"},
  {"company": "Shopify", "use": "YJIT, the Ruby JIT compiler", "source": "https://shopify.engineering/ruby-yjit-is-production-ready"},
  {"company": "npm, Inc.", "use": "Authorization service in the registry", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/static/pdfs/Rust-npm-Whitepaper.pdf"},
  {"company": "Buoyant (Linkerd)", "use": "linkerd2-proxy service mesh data plane", "source": "https://linkerd.io/2020/07/23/under-the-hood-of-linkerds-state-of-the-art-rust-proxy-linkerd2-proxy/"},
  {"company": "Fastly", "use": "Lucet WebAssembly compiler and runtime for Compute", "source": "https://www.fastly.com/blog/announcing-lucet-fastly-native-webassembly-compiler-runtime"},
  {"company": "Vercel", "use": "Turbopack bundler", "source": "https://vercel.com/blog/turbopack"},
  {"company": "Deno Land", "use": "Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime", "source": "https://deno.com/blog/v1"},
  {"company": "Datadog", "use": "Vector observability data pipeline", "source": "https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/datadog-acquires-timber-technologies-vector/"},
  {"company": "Oxide Computer", "use": "Hubris embedded OS and rack-scale server firmware and software", "source": "https://oxide.computer/blog/hubris-and-humility"},
  {"company": "Materialize", "use": "Streaming SQL database", "source": "https://github.com/MaterializeInc/materialize"},
  {"company": "InfluxData", "use": "InfluxDB 3 (IOx) time-series engine", "source": "https://www.influxdata.com/blog/announcing-influxdb-iox/"},
  {"company": "Zed Industries", "use": "Zed code editor", "source": "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed"},
  {"company": "1Password", "use": "Core shared code across its apps", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/production/users"},
  {"company": "Astral", "use": "uv and Ruff Python tooling", "source": "https://astral.sh/blog/uv"},
  {"company": "PingCAP", "use": "TiKV distributed key-value store behind TiDB", "source": "https://github.com/tikv/tikv"},
  {"company": "Brave Software", "use": "Ad-blocking engine in the Brave browser", "source": "https://github.com/brave/adblock-rust"},
  {"company": "Hugging Face", "use": "tokenizers and safetensors libraries", "source": "https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers"},
  {"company": "System76", "use": "COSMIC desktop environment", "source": "https://system76.com/cosmic"},
  {"company": "Sentry", "use": "Relay event-processing service", "source": "https://github.com/getsentry/relay"},
  {"company": "Svix", "use": "Webhook sending service", "source": "https://github.com/svix/svix-webhooks"},
  {"company": "Embark Studios", "use": "Game development tooling and infrastructure", "source": "https://github.com/EmbarkStudios"},
  {"company": "Wasmer", "use": "WebAssembly runtime", "source": "https://github.com/wasmerio/wasmer"}
]
```

I can fetch each link to check it and replace any that fail.
